title: One complete physical set of A hanging black-iron citadel over molten rivers, storm ash, slag-gold fire in the clouds, and broken sky-chains. The entire place is visible at once, as a single architectural model, ground included. No people, animals, or readable text. The set contains citadel core: One black-iron fortress tower, square slag-stone walls, hanging chains, a single building with no ground and no other structures.; chain pylon: One tall narrow lattice transmission tower of black iron, standing alone, no wires and no landscape.. The model is about 200 meters wide, 240 meters deep, and 140 meters tall.
